guarantees.claim: On reset (rst_ni low), both rx_timeout_count_q and rx_fifo_depth_prev_q are synchronously assigned to 0 immediately after the clock edge where reset is sampled low.
On every positive clock edge when not in reset, rx_timeout_count_q updates to the value of rx_timeout_count_d and rx_fifo_depth_prev_q updates to the value of rx_fifo_depth.

uncertain_points.claim: rx_fifo_depth is captured directly without any synchronization; if it comes from a different clock domain (e.g., from rx_fifo in a separate clock), metastability may corrupt rx_fifo_depth_prev_q and could propagate to dependent timeout logic.
uncertain_points.cond: if rx_fifo_depth is asynchronous to clk_i
uncertain_points.risk: If rx_fifo_depth is asynchronous, glitches or metastability could cause incorrect timeout detection or FIFO depth tracking, leading to unexpected UART receive behavior.
